notes.title: Guilded Hearts: New BL Visual Novel!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e651c7a8d52d3015d5fc7044dc76c5455025283b.jpg

Demo + Kickstarter Coming FALL 2022!
🧡 Join the Discord Server
🧡 Follow Gallium Games on Twitter
🧡 Development Blog

[hr]
A new BxB visual novel from Gallium Games!
We're super excited to announce our newest VN project: Guilded Hearts!

It's a slice-of-life/romance BL visual novel (optional 18+ content) centered around a fantasy MMO. Customize your MC's name/appearance and romance four potential fellow players!

Read more about Guilded Hearts + add it to your wishlist!
Check out GH's Steam page below and wishlist it to be notified upon release! (Wishlists help out our visibility immensely <3)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2105700/Guilded_Hearts
